### Version 0.3.1 of the Teardown APWorld!


New releases have been moved to https://github.com/Evereliquest/Teardown-Archipelago


Taking a break from full integration to fix bugs and add options.

As of this version I think it's ready for asyncs, and will be using it myself. Report any logic bugs or mishaps that happen while playing, I can't know otherwise.

Follow the install directions in the Official Archipelago Discord, within the Teardown thread in Future Game Design


## Changes
- Fully fixed Cash
- Add option to change amount of starting tools
- Add option to change amount of starting levels
- Fixed a few bugs in the apworld found by running it though the fuzzer
- Started cleaning up the code, more to come
- The client now says Archipelago Teardown Client (though some commands still don't work, more to come)
